tools.name: doorloop_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the DoorLoop user that created this API key. Good first call to confirm the connection. DoorLoop API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: doorloop_list_properties
tools.description: List properties (buildings) with address, class and portfolio. DoorLoop API: GET /properties.

tools.name: doorloop_get_property
tools.description: Get one property by id. DoorLoop API: GET /properties/{propertyId}.

tools.name: doorloop_list_units
tools.description: List rental units with rent, bedrooms and status. Without filter_active the API returns active units only. DoorLoop API: GET /units.

tools.name: doorloop_get_unit
tools.description: Get one unit by id. DoorLoop API: GET /units/{unitId}.

tools.name: doorloop_list_leases
tools.description: List leases with dates, rent, status and outstanding balance. Use calculatedStatus or situation to find at-risk or late leases. DoorLoop API: GET /leases.

tools.name: doorloop_get_lease
tools.description: Get one lease by id. DoorLoop API: GET /leases/{leaseId}.

tools.name: doorloop_list_lease_tenants
tools.description: List tenants joined to their leases, with move-in and move-out dates. Best way to map tenants to leases. DoorLoop API: GET /leases/tenants.

tools.name: doorloop_list_tenants
tools.description: List tenants and prospects with contact details. DoorLoop API: GET /tenants.

tools.name: doorloop_get_tenant
tools.description: Get one tenant by id. DoorLoop API: GET /tenants/{tenantId}.

tools.name: doorloop_list_lease_payments
tools.description: List rent payments received on leases. DoorLoop API: GET /lease-payments.

tools.name: doorloop_list_lease_charges
tools.description: List charges (rent, fees, late fees) billed on leases. Use totalBalanceGreaterThan to find unpaid charges. DoorLoop API: GET /lease-charges.

tools.name: doorloop_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, work orders, tenant requests and owner requests. DoorLoop API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: doorloop_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id. DoorLoop API: GET /tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: doorloop_list_owners
tools.description: List property owners. DoorLoop API: GET /owners.

tools.name: doorloop_list_vendors
tools.description: List maintenance vendors. DoorLoop API: GET /vendors.

tools.name: doorloop_list_portfolios
tools.description: List portfolios (property groups). DoorLoop API: GET /property-groups.

tools.name: doorloop_list_users
tools.description: List DoorLoop users of the company. DoorLoop API: GET /users.

tools.name: doorloop_list_accounts
tools.description: List chart-of-accounts entries. DoorLoop API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: doorloop_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task in DoorLoop. INTERNAL_TASK needs requested_by_user, TENANT_REQUEST needs requested_by_tenant, OWNER_REQUEST needs requested_by_owner, WORK_ORDER needs assigned_to_vendor. Notifications are off unless you set them. Each call creates a new task. DoorLoop API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: doorloop_post_task_update
tools.description: WRITE: post a message on an existing task and optionally change its status, priority, due date or assignees. Each call adds a new update. Notifications are off unless you set them. DoorLoop API: POST /tasks/update.
